title: Settings
addToBottom: Add new items to the bottom
moveChecked: Move checked items to bottom of list
calendarFeedHint: Subscribe to your reminders in Google Calendar, Thunderbird or any app that reads iCalendar. Anyone with the link can read your reminder titles.
deleteAllHint: Permanently deletes every note you own, including the ones in the trash, and the labels you created.
deleteAllBody_one: 1 note you own will be deleted forever. This cannot be undone — it does not go to the trash.
deleteAllBody_other: {{count}} notes you own will be deleted forever. This cannot be undone — they do not go to the trash.
deleteAllLabels_one: 1 label you created will be deleted too.
deleteAllLabels_other: {{count}} labels you created will be deleted too.
deleteAllShared_one: 1 note shared with you will be removed from your list only; the owner keeps it.
deleteAllShared_other: {{count}} notes shared with you will be removed from your list only; their owners keep them.
